description: This file defines a GUI component for displaying and interacting with behavior coding maps in the BORIS software. It includes a QWidget subclass with embedded QGraphicsView for visualizing polygons over a bitmap, and functions to load and display behavior maps, handle user interactions, and integrate with the main application.

classes.name: BehaviorsCodingMapWindowClass
classes.description: Main widget class for displaying and interacting with behavior coding maps, including nested View class for handling mouse events and rendering polygons.

methods.name: show_behaviors_coding_map
methods.description: Function to display a behavior coding map, prompting user to select from available maps and creating or showing the corresponding window.
